question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
-- Final query: Get the customer with the largest month-over-month payment change (absolute)
WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
    ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) as payment_month,
        SUM(p.amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10)
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        mp.customer_id,
        t.first_name,
        t.last_name,
        mp.payment_month,
        mp.monthly_total,
        LAG(mp.monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY mp.customer_id ORDER BY mp.payment_month) as prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_payments mp
    JOIN top10 t ON mp.customer_id = t.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    payment_month,
    ROUND(ABS(monthly_total - prev_month_total), 2) as mom_diff
FROM with_lag
WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(mom_diff) DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Step 1: Find the top 10 paying customers (by total payment amount)
